samples.reason: This is an open-ended explanatory/generative task requiring the model to reason through a multi-stage physics scenario and lay it out coherently for trainees. Petrel leads on all relevant internal evals (Creative Generation, Support Dialogue) and on every public benchmark, and its strong positive slope for generative, open-latitude composition matches this walkthrough request. Willet's documented aversion to open-ended generative work makes it the weaker fit despite the capability dissociation.
